metadata.title: MedDeID English synthetic clinical corpus, benchmark and annotation guideline
metadata.description: A synthetic English clinical-text de-identification release containing 6,700 model-development documents and a disjoint 300-document human-validated benchmark, balanced between en-GB and en-US. The benchmark contains 1,717 primary PII spans and 7,358 confirmed nested core-PII subannotation segments. The archive also contains the English annotation guideline and provenance manifests. It contains no real patient notes or personal information.
